headlines.title: ExxonMobil to Receive Port Houston’s 4th Annual Lone Star Award at HIMC
headlines.summary: HOUSTON, October 13, 2026--Port Houston will honor ExxonMobil with the 4th Annual Lone Star Award during the Houston International Maritime Conference (HIMC), taking place November 2–5 at the Hilton Americas in downtown Houston. The award recognizes ExxonMobil’s exceptional partnership with Port Houston and its longstanding role in the energy industry that is integral to the Houston Ship Channel.

headlines.title: Will Elevated Crude Prices Enhance ExxonMobil's Cash Flows?
headlines.summary: XOM stands to benefit from oil prices above $90 per barrel, with low-cost production in the Permian and Guyana supporting its earnings and cash flow outlook.

headlines.title: ExxonMobil (XOM) Trades at a Premium Yet Earnings Are Expected to Shrink
headlines.summary: Few companies can turn a messy quarter into a giant one, but ExxonMobil (NYSE:XOM) pulled it off in the second quarter of 2026. War-related disruptions in the Middle East scrambled energy markets, and Exxon still posted adjusted earnings of $14.7 billion, up from $8.8 billion in the first quarter. The business is easy to picture.

headlines.title: Exxon, Oil Giants Top Buy Points After Deadly Saudi Airport Attacks
headlines.summary: Attacks on a major Saudi airport and oil tankers in Hormuz revived supply fears and lifted oil prices. Exxon, Chevron and other oil majors are in buy areas.

description: ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation engages in the exploration and production of crude oil and natural gas in the United States, Canada, and internationally. The company operates through Upstream, Energy Products, Chemical Products, and Specialty Products segments. Its Upstream segment explores for and produces crude oil and natural gas. The Energy Products segment offers fuels, aromatics, and catalysts, as well as licensing services. Its Chemical Products segment manufactures and sells olefins, polyolefins, and intermediates. The Specialty Products segment offers finished lubricants, basestocks, waxes, synthetics, elastomers, and resins. It is also involved in the manufacture, trade, transport, and sale of crude oil, natural gas, petroleum products, petrochemicals, and other specialty products; and pursuit of lower-emission and business opportunities, including carbon capture and storage, hydrogen, lower-emission fuels, Proxxima resin systems, carbon materials, low-carbon data center, and lithium. In addition, the company offers aviation fuel. It sells its products under the Exxon, Esso, and Mobil brands. The company was formerly known as Exxon Mobil Corporation and changed its name to ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation in July 2026. ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation was founded in 1870 and is headquartered in Spring, Texas.
